behavior: The map's Colour by control has a Link option. While it is on, the map reads the intake target of one building of the area (the opened package's building, else a proposed building, else the selected or first building; the same query and key as the property card) for its case, then GET /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/intake/evidence page after page along the cursor (200 candidates a page, at most 10 pages), under the batch's evidence key. Each page read colours its buildings at once. A building takes the outcome of the candidates whose anchors name its feature: conflicting over several buildings over matched. Matched is --ui-mark-good, several buildings --ui-seq-400, conflicting --ui-mark-warning (amber, never red); a building no candidate names keeps the default colour. The key lists Matched, Several buildings, Conflicting and Unmatched (the S6.1b words) with the S6.1b icons (check, warning, warning, question) and the case's page counts exactly as read, then 'No link' with the default swatch, and a note: 'N buildings coloured from T candidates. Unmatched rows and pages name no building.'; while pages are still being read or remain past the bound, 'N buildings coloured from R of T candidates read' (with '; the rest are listed in the batch.' when the bound stops the read). No batch: 'No batch names a building of this area.' A failed read: 'The links could not be read.' with the server's words. Read only; no new route; no count is typed in.
